chapters.summary: Paul gives thanks to God for the Thessalonian believers' faith, love, and hope, and commends them for imitating the Lord and becoming an example to others.
keyPoints: Paul gives thanks to God for the believers' faith, love, and hope, because they are chosen of God.
The gospel came to them not in word only, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit.
Amid affliction the believers received the word, imitating Paul and the Lord, and became an example to all in Macedonia and Achaia.
chapters.application: May we live out the gospel through faith, love, and hope, finding joy in the Lord even amid affliction, and become a good example to those around us.

chapters.summary: Paul looks back on his ministry in Thessalonica, emphasizing his pure motives and parental love for the believers, and gives thanks that they received the true word.
keyPoints: Paul's preaching did not spring from error or deceit, but from being entrusted by God, seeking to please God rather than men.
Paul was gentle among them like a nursing mother caring for her children, sharing his very life with them, and like a father he exhorted and comforted them.
The Thessalonian believers accepted the true word, and though they suffered at the hands of their own countrymen, they imitated the Lord and the churches of God.
chapters.application: In service and in life, examine whether your motives are pure. Treat others with gentleness and sincerity, as a parent cares for a child, and be willing to pay the cost for the sake of others.

chapters.summary: Paul is deeply comforted when Timotheus brings back good news of the Thessalonian believers' faith and love, and he prays for their continued growth.
keyPoints: While Paul was in Athens, concerned for the Thessalonian believers, he sent Timotheus to establish and strengthen their faith.
Timotheus brought back good news, reporting their faith and love, and their longing to see Paul again.
Paul was comforted by this, and prayed that God would increase their love, strengthen their hearts, and make them holy.
chapters.application: When you are in affliction, imitate the Thessalonian believers - hold fast to faith and love, find comfort in the good testimony of others, and continue to support one another.

chapters.summary: Paul exhorts the Thessalonian believers to live holy lives, and comforts them concerning the resurrection of those who have fallen asleep and the return of the Lord.
keyPoints: Believers are urged to please God and to walk in a manner that is increasingly upright.
Holiness and self-control are emphasized, calling believers to avoid sexual immorality and to treat others with honor.
Believers are comforted with the truth that at the Lord's coming, those who have died in Christ will rise first.
chapters.application: In everyday life, let us pursue holiness, treat others with love, and hold fast to the hope of the Lord's return, comforting brothers and sisters who have lost loved ones.

chapters.summary: Paul exhorts believers to stay watchful and ready for the day of the Lord, and gives instructions for church life and personal sanctification.
keyPoints: The day of the Lord will come suddenly, like a thief in the night, so believers must stay watchful and sober.
Believers are children of light, and should equip themselves with faith, love, and hope, encouraging and building up one another.
Believers should honor those who labor among them, live at peace with one another, warn those who are unruly, and rejoice, pray, and give thanks continually.
chapters.application: Live each day with a watchful heart, always rejoicing, praying, and giving thanks, treating those around you with kindness as you await the Lord's return.
